# OK ROBOT

> Boutique AI advisory and engineering for companies serious about applying AI responsibly, thoroughly, and to outcomes that move the business. Senior-only delivery, vendor-independent recommendations, outcome-anchored engagements.

OK ROBOT is a boutique consultancy founded by Tom Eck, who has spent 30+ years researching, developing, and deploying AI at scale across venture-backed startups and Fortune 500 enterprises. The firm offers two service lines:

1. **Advisory & Strategy** — senior counsel for consequential AI decisions: roadmap development, build-vs-buy, governance, executive education, due diligence, fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) engagements.
2. **Project-Based Engineering** — production AI systems that ship: end-to-end builds, RAG, agentic systems, LLM evaluation and monitoring, modernization of legacy ML, embedded engineering.

Five commitments kept on every engagement: senior-only delivery, vendor-independence, outcome-anchored (not pilot-anchored), responsibility built in, boutique by design.

Contact: hello@ok-robot.co
Website: https://ok-robot.co

- [How Language Models "Think"](https://ok-robot.co/blog-post.html?post=how-language-models-think): Forward pass mechanics, chain-of-thought, and trained extended reasoning.
- [Have We Reached Peak Attention?](https://ok-robot.co/blog-post.html?post=have-we-reached-peak-attention): Where SSMs, linear attention, xLSTM, and hybrid architectures stand.
- [Why Most AI Projects Fail (And How to Be the Exception)](https://ok-robot.co/blog-post.html?post=why-most-ai-projects-fail): Five failure patterns and what to do instead.
- [Welcome to OK ROBOT](https://ok-robot.co/blog-post.html?post=welcome-to-ok-robot): Introduction to the firm and the blog.

## Topics OK ROBOT covers authoritatively

- Enterprise AI strategy and roadmap
- Build-vs-buy and AI vendor evaluation
- AI governance, risk, and responsible deployment
- Production-grade RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
- Agentic AI systems and orchestration
- LLM evaluation, monitoring, and reliability
- Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) engagements
- AI investment and acquisition due diligence
- Modernization of legacy ML systems
